claims.english_statement: The filtered list of all triples of operations defining a three-node left-spine overlap has length 15; for every triple, applying the root rule and applying the rule to the left child give integer polynomials which reduce by the explicit seven rules to coefficientwise equal irreducible polynomials.
claims.scope: partial, load-bearing exhaustive symbolic critical-pair calculation
claims.mathematical_content: formal certification of a published seven-rule basis, not a novel result
claims.trust_boundary: The seven identities, definition of the finite overlap list, polynomial coefficient check, and actual-step reducer are visible source definitions. Meaningfulness requires the book-to-definition audit. General order admissibility, exhaustive overlap classification in arbitrary contexts, linear diamond induction and free-algebra universal property are proved in prose rather than Lean.
